observations: Graphics InternalResolution, FrameSkip and AutoFrameSkip are native per-game settings.
Manual frameskip is inactive while automatic frameskip is on.
Enabling automatic frameskip can turn off SkipBufferEffects; the shell rejects that conflict without editing the owner setting.
Resolution is inactive with SoftwareRenderer or SkipBufferEffects; the shell reports that conflict.
Non-VR per-game configuration filenames use PPSSPP game IDs, never shell path hashes or ROM basenames.
